title: Reinforcement Learning Improves LLM Accuracy and Reasoning in Disease Classification from Radiology Reports

live_model.evidence: Methods: 'Labels ... were automatically extracted using GPT-4o (gpt-4o-2024-05-13) through prompting (Prompt 2)'; Suppl. Table S2: GPT4-o 0.758 [0.707, 0.813] (MIMIC micro-F1)

prompt.location: Methods: Prompt 2 (disease-list extraction from a report) and Prompt 1 (reasoning template)

claim.metric: micro-F1, disease classification, MIMIC-CXR gold evaluation set
claim.location: Supplementary Table S2, row GPT4-o, MIMIC block (Figure 2)

data.source: MIMIC-CXR (PhysioNet credentialed access; 100 author-annotated evaluation reports), NIH-CXR 50 reports, MIDRC 50 reports (labels from prior work [12], release not stated)

notes: MIMIC-CXR requires credentialed PhysioNet access and its data-use terms restrict sending reports to commercial APIs; the radiologist gold labels for the 100/50/50 evaluation reports are not released. GPT-4o also acts as reasoning evaluator (role A) elsewhere.
